arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Overpowers{/c} will spawn an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds that deals {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"]{/c} seconds. Your Earthquake damage is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|%x|]{/c} for every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Strength you have, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3" * 100|x%|]{/c}.

Current Bonus: {c_number}[Min(Affix."Static Value 3", Floor(Owner.Strength_Total / Affix."Static Value 1") * Affix."Static Value 0") * 100|x%|]{/c}

Your {c_important}Overpowers{/c} spawn an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} that deals {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage. Your {c_important}Earthquakes{/c} deal more damage for every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Strength you have.
